authorization: User requests a more flexible parity pass that records all issues without aborting, to assess their extent and severity.
relationship_to_original: Separate diagnostic adaptation. Preserve the closed exact-parity failure and its original gate. This census does not retroactively pass that gate.

behavior.reconstruction: Original public initialization, chronological ADC input, saved accepted x at each block, re_commit only.
behavior.continue: Record every finite scalar mismatch and output flag mismatch; continue through the complete registered two-hour prefix.
behavior.stop: Missing or changed inputs, invalid/nonfinite expected data, source/order failure, invalid live bank, failed model/commit/query, output failure or resource limit.
behavior.saved_fields: All 27 binary64 fields and index/flags/phase/availability at every snapshot, including matching values.
behavior.checkpoint: Pointer-free host-ABI diagnostic bank with distinct FPSHC01 magic; not accepted by the old strict checkpoint loader.

analysis.mismatch_inventory: Lossless gzip CSV with each mismatched sample, elapsed time, field, actual/expected decimal and hex values, signed/absolute/relative difference and ULP distance.
analysis.per_field: Counts, first/last occurrence, largest absolute and relative errors, largest ULP distance, ULP histogram and consecutive mismatch run length.
analysis.signed_zero: Bitwise sign difference recorded separately; numerical difference and ULP distance zero.
analysis.severity_context: Costs compared descriptively with the existing 0.1-NLL shape budget; SOC differences converted to percentage points and compared with the existing 0.5-pp target; RC voltages compared with the existing 1-mV likelihood sigma. These ratios are context, not new acceptance tolerances.
analysis.time_windows: Fixed 900-second nominal windows over the two-hour prefix; retain actual saved elapsed times in all rows.
analysis.limits: Saved point/endpoint parity does not establish equality of unsaved bank coefficients, joint curvature, uncertainty coverage or library attribution. Saved accepted x is installed by construction, not independently re-estimated.

finish_line: Complete mismatch inventory with magnitude and temporal summaries, or explicit partial inventory if a structural failure prevents continuation. No threshold tuning or inference retry.
